title: From Distributed Databases to AI Data Platforms: OceanBase Seeks Independent Funding and Accelerates Global Expansion
excerpt: According to Bloomberg, the distributed database vendor OceanBase is in talks with several top institutions for an A-round financing of 2 to 3 billion yuan, aim
content_html:
According to Bloomberg, the distributed database vendor OceanBase is in talks with several top institutions for an A-round financing of 2 to 3 billion yuan, aiming to enhance its independent operations and accelerate its expansion into an AI data platform. According to insiders, OceanBase's annualized revenue reached over 1.4 billion yuan in 2026, representing a year-on-year growth of about 70%. It has thousands of customers, including Bank of Communications and China Mobile, and has already expanded into overseas markets such as Southeast Asia, Japan, India, and Latin America. Ant Group, OceanBase, and Ant Digital have not responded to requests for comments.

In terms of technology and products, OceanBase was born in 2010 and has undergone years of testing during the "Singles' Day" traffic surges. According to an IDC report, it ranked first in the local deployment market share of distributed databases in China in 2025. The company now competes with Databricks, expanding from core transaction systems to full-scale enterprise data management and Agent data supply, enhancing unstructured data processing capabilities, and launching a new generation of lakehouse-integrated AI database in June of this year to advance commercialization.

Since establishing an independent board of directors and an independent equity incentive mechanism in 2024, OceanBase has significantly accelerated its market-oriented progress. This financing marks a key step forward in OceanBase's independent operations and reflects that Ant Group's innovative business is gradually building an independent governance and financing mechanism, accelerating its journey toward external market validation.

content_html_zh:
据彭博社报道，分布式数据库厂商OceanBase正在与多家顶级机构洽谈2-30亿元A轮融资，旨在增强其独立运营能力，加速向AI数据平台扩张。 据业内人士透露，2026年OceanBase年化收入将超过14亿元，同比增长约70%。 拥有交通银行、中国移动等数千家客户，并已拓展至东南亚、日本、印度、拉美等海外市场。 蚂蚁集团、OceanBase 和 Ant Digital 尚未回应置评请求。

从技术和产品上来说，OceanBase诞生于2010年，在“双十一”流量激增期间经历了多年的考验。 IDC报告显示，2025年中国分布式数据库本地部署市场份额排名第一。 该公司目前与Databricks展开竞争，从核心交易系统拓展到全面的企业数据管理和Agent数据供应，增强非结构化数据处理能力，并于今年6月推出新一代lakehouse集成AI数据库，推进商业化。

自2024年建立独立董事会和独立股权激励机制以来，OceanBase的市场化进程明显加快。 本次融资标志着OceanBase独立运营迈出关键一步，体现了蚂蚁集团创新业务正在逐步构建独立的治理和融资机制，加速走向外部市场验证的征程。
